import json, hashlib, datetime
root=Path('/home/yongpeng/cross-lingual')
out=root/'reports/seller_alias_continual/20260910/cause_train_execution/20260910_122620'
def rec(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''): h.update(b)
 return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':h.hexdigest()}
m=json.loads((out/'run/manifest.json').read_text())
assert (out/'exit_status.txt').read_text().strip()=='0'
assert not (out/'run/failure.json').exists()
files=[rec(p) for p in sorted((out/'run').rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.suffix!='.pt']
files += [rec(out/n) for n in ('started.txt','finished.txt','exit_status.txt','resource_usage.log','train.log','launcher.log','launcher.pid')]
models=[rec(out/'run'/r['path']) for r in m['retained_files_verified']]
for got,expected in zip(models,m['retained_files_verified']):
 assert got['bytes']==expected['bytes'] and got['sha256']==expected['sha256']
receipt={'checked_at':datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'status':m['status'],'files':files,'linux_retained_models':models,'source_files':m['source_files'],'physical_updates':m['physical_updates'],'budget':m['budget'],'formal_training_seconds':m['formal_training_seconds'],'inference_seconds_including_replay':m['inference_seconds_including_replay']}
(out/'completion_transfer.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k not in ('files','source_files','linux_retained_models')}))
print('return_files',len(files),'bytes',sum(x['bytes'] for x in files))
